stories.headline: Samsung foundry sees surge in chip orders from Google, AMD, BYD, Tesla as TSMC capacity tightens

key_facts.fact: Nikkei Asia, citing six people with knowledge of the matter, reports BYD, Google, AMD and Tesla are turning to Samsung Electronics for contract chipmaking as TSMC's advanced capacity stays constrained by AI demand
key_facts.excerpt: BYD, Google, AMD, Tesla and others are looking increasingly to Samsung Electronics for contract chipmaking services as surging demand for AI infrastructure strains the advanced chipmaking capacity of market leader TSMC, Nikkei Asia has learned.

key_facts.fact: Google is in discussions to have Samsung produce its next-generation Axion server CPUs and a portion of its Tensor Processing Units, both targeted to launch around 2028 — if finalized it would be the first time Google shifts TPU manufacturing away from TSMC
key_facts.excerpt: Google is exploring having Samsung manufacture its next-generation Axion processor, scheduled for release in 2028, and some TPU chips; if the partnership is finalized, it would mark the first time Google has shifted TPU manufacturing orders away from TSMC.

key_facts.fact: BYD is negotiating with Samsung for production of its Xuanji A3 series 4nm and next-generation 2nm gate-all-around (GAA) autonomous driving chips
key_facts.excerpt: BYD is currently negotiating with Samsung on future autonomous driving chip production, involving the Xuanji A3 series 4nm and next-generation 2nm GAA smart driving chips.

key_facts.fact: AMD is in talks to have Samsung manufacture some CPUs starting in 2028
key_facts.excerpt: AMD is in talks to have Samsung build some future CPUs.

key_facts.fact: Tesla's AI6 chip is confirmed for production at Samsung's Taylor, Texas plant, building on the $16.5B foundry deal signed in 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla's AI6 chip has been confirmed for production at Samsung's Taylor plant in Texas.

key_facts.fact: TSMC's order book is heavily committed to Nvidia, Apple, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell and MediaTek, leaving little near-term room for new orders despite planned capacity expansion
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC's order book is heavily committed to existing customers — Nvidia, Apple, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell, and MediaTek among them — leaving little room for new orders in the near term.

stories.headline: Snap unveils Specs, $2,195 standalone AR glasses for preorder, shipping fall 2026

key_facts.fact: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel unveiled Specs at Augmented World Expo in Long Beach on June 16, 2026, opening preorders at $2,195 with a $200 refundable deposit
key_facts.excerpt: Today at Augmented World Expo 2026, we introduced SPECS, our new augmented reality glasses. Today, SPECS are available for pre-order at SPECS.COM for $2,195, with a $200 refundable deposit.

key_facts.fact: Specs are expected to ship this fall in the United States, the United Kingdom and France
key_facts.excerpt: Snap says they're expected to ship 'this fall' in the US, UK, and France.

key_facts.fact: Specs weigh 132 grams and offer a 51-degree field of view, putting them between Meta's prototype Orion (98g, 70°) and Magic Leap 2 (260g, 70°)
key_facts.excerpt: Snap Specs(2026) | ThickGlasses(132g) | 51° | Product($2195)

key_facts.fact: Battery life is up to four hours, with a charging case providing four additional charges
key_facts.excerpt: A look at Specs, which have a battery life of up to four hours and a case with four charges

key_facts.fact: Developers can use Anthropic's Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex and Cursor coding tools to build AI agent experiences for Specs via a preview integration
key_facts.excerpt: Developers will also be able to create AI agent-like experiences for the device using a preview feature that integrates with Anthropic's Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex and Cursor's coding tools.

key_facts.fact: Price is more than 15 times the $130 camera-only Spectacles Snap debuted in 2016, with Spiegel framing Specs as 'the beginning of a new era in computing' nearly 20 years after the iPhone
key_facts.excerpt: At $2,195 with a $200 refundable deposit, Specs are more than 15 times the price of Snap's $130 camera-only Spectacles that debuted in 2016 and never became a hit.

stories.headline: Qualcomm unveils Snapdragon Reality Elite XR chip; Xreal Aura first device, ships fall

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm announced Snapdragon Reality Elite at AWE 2026 in Long Beach on June 16, its new flagship XR chipset designed for both standalone headsets and tethered compute pucks, in either passthrough or see-through display systems
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm just announced Snapdragon Reality Elite, its new flagship XR chipset, and it will debut in the compute puck of Xreal's Aura Android XR device this fall.

key_facts.fact: Versus the previous Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 (used in Samsung Galaxy XR), Reality Elite promises 60% greater GPU performance, 30% greater CPU performance and 160% greater NPU performance reaching 48 TOPS
key_facts.excerpt: 60% greater GPU performance. 30% greater CPU performance. 160% greater NPU performance for machine learning tasks (48 TOPS).

key_facts.fact: Reality Elite delivers up to 20% longer battery life at the same workload and runs up to 12°C cooler under load than XR2+ Gen 2
key_facts.excerpt: The cumulative efficiency gains mean that Qualcomm can promise up to 20% longer battery life and, more importantly, an SoC that can run up to 12°C cooler under load.

key_facts.fact: Xreal officially unveiled the Xreal Aura — formerly Project Aura — as the first device to use Snapdragon Reality Elite, built with Google and Qualcomm and integrating Android XR with Gemini
key_facts.excerpt: XREAL, the global leader in lightweight XR glasses, today officially unveiled XREAL AURA, powered by Android XR and built with Snapdragon.

key_facts.fact: Xreal Aura weighs under 95 grams, will ship this fall in the US, UK, Japan, Canada and South Korea, with reservations open for $99 and a $199 launch credit (effectively $100 off) for those who reserve within two weeks
key_facts.excerpt: Reservations for the second Android XR device, now dubbed the Xreal Aura, are available for $99 starting today, with a full launch in the US, UK, Japan, Canada, and South Korea expected sometime this Fall.

key_facts.fact: Xreal has not disclosed Aura's final price but says it will 'not exceed $1500'
key_facts.excerpt: The company is not yet announcing the price, nor many of the key specifications, other than to say that it will 'not exceed $1500'.

stories.headline: Microsoft launches Surface Pro 12 and Laptop 8 on Snapdragon X2, $500-$600 price hike

key_facts.fact: Microsoft launched the Surface Pro 12 (13-inch) starting at $1,499 and the Surface Laptop 8 (13.8-inch and 15-inch) starting at $1,599, both powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 chips, available June 16, with Surface for Business versions following on July 14
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're introducing the next Surface Pro and Surface Laptop, powered by Snapdragon X2 processors. The next Surface Pro and Surface Laptop ship with Snapdragon X2 processors... These new PCs are available starting June 16, with Surface for Business availability beginning July 14.

key_facts.fact: Starting prices are $500 higher for the Pro (was $999) and $600 higher for the Laptop (was $999) versus 2024 models, with Engadget attributing the increase to RAM and storage price spikes driven by AI investment
key_facts.excerpt: The new 13-inch Surface Pro starts at $1,499 (a $500 increase) while the updated Surface Pro 13.8-inch is a whopping $600 more expensive at $1,599. But I suppose Microsoft only has itself to blame, as its investments in AI are the biggest reason RAM and storage prices have skyrocketed lately.

key_facts.fact: Configurations use the 10-core Snapdragon X2 Plus or 12-core X2 Elite chips, skipping the 18-core X2 Elite and X2 Elite Extreme variants Qualcomm launched last year
key_facts.excerpt: The new 13.8-inch and 15-inch Laptops will include the Snapdragon X2 Plus 10-core chip, as well as the Snapdragon X2 Elite 12-core processor, passing over the 18-core X2 Elite and the 18-core X2 Elite Extreme that Qualcomm launched last year.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft claims up to 53% faster graphics on the Surface Pro and up to 58% faster on the Surface Laptop versus prior generation, with 15.5h battery life on the Pro and up to 20h on the 13.8-inch Laptop
key_facts.excerpt: Starting at $1,499 (MSRP), the new Surface Pro 13-inch with Snapdragon X2 delivers up to 53% faster graphic performance than the previous generation, up to 15.5 hours of battery life... Starting at $1,599 (MSRP), the Surface Laptop pairs the premium build quality Surface is known for with the power of Snapdragon X2 with up to 58% more graphics performance than the previous generation. The new Laptop delivers up to 20 hours of battery life on the 13.8-inch and up to 19 hours on the 15-inch.

key_facts.fact: Memory options span 16/24/32/64GB and storage options 256GB to 2TB on removable PCIe Gen 4 SSDs, with new Jade Surface Laptop and Dune Surface Pro Flex Keyboard color options
key_facts.excerpt: The Pro starts at $1,499 with 256GB of storage (before adding a keyboard or stylus), and the Laptop starts at $1,599 with a 512GB SSD — each with 16GB of RAM, with configs that go much higher.

stories.headline: World models startup Odyssey raises $310M at $1.45B valuation; Amazon joins, deploys AWS Trainium

key_facts.fact: Odyssey ML raised a $310 million funding round at a $1.45 billion valuation, with Amazon investing alongside the venture arms of Nvidia and AMD
key_facts.excerpt: Company joins investment arms of Nvidia and AMD in $310mn funding round for Odyssey ML — Amazon is partnering with a start...

key_facts.fact: Odyssey will use AWS as its preferred cloud partner and deploy Amazon's Trainium chips for training and serving its world models
key_facts.excerpt: World models startup Odyssey raised $310M from Amazon and others at a $1.45B valuation and will use AWS as its preferred cloud partner, deploying Trainium chips

key_facts.fact: Amazon's direct investment in Odyssey comes as hyperscaler AI capex is projected to climb from roughly $650 billion in 2026 to more than $1.1 trillion in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon (AMZN) joined a $310M funding round for AI startup Odyssey ML, investing directly in the company. Hyperscalers' AI spending may jump from ~$650B in 2026 to $1.1T+ in 2027; Amazon (AMZN) is a key spender, boosting data center and AI-accelerator investment.

key_facts.fact: Odyssey was founded in 2023 in San Francisco; its latest model Odyssey-2 Pro is positioned as a general-purpose world simulator with applications in robotics, gaming, education and defense
key_facts.excerpt: Since founding Odyssey two years ago, our singular focus has been to research and deploy frontier world models. Our latest model, Odyssey-2 Pro, is a breakthrough general-purpose world model, which developers can now integrate with all kinds of applications, from robotics to gaming to education to defense and much more.

stories.headline: Apple targets late-2027 launch for camera AirPods, iPhone 20 Pro and 2nm A21 chips

key_facts.fact: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods, code-named B798, are scheduled to launch in late 2027, slipping from an original 2026 target due to AI software delays — they are Apple's first AI-focused wearable
key_facts.excerpt: Apple Inc.'s upcoming camera-equipped AirPods, a product meant to vault the company into the AI device market, is scheduled to launch in late 2027 as part of a flurry of new releases... The AirPods, code-named B798, were originally slated for release in 2026, according to the people. The deadline slipped in part because of Apple's prolonged struggles with artificial intelligence software.

key_facts.fact: AirPods cameras are not designed to capture photos or video — they act as sensors that feed visual context to Siri, with onboard lights indicating when data is being sent to the cloud
key_facts.excerpt: The cameras in the AirPods are not designed for taking photos and videos, and will instead send information about the wearer's surroundings to Siri. Siri will be able to answer questions about objects and whatever the wearer is looking at.

key_facts.fact: Alongside the AirPods, Apple plans to release a 20th-anniversary iPhone 20 Pro (V73) and iPhone 20 Max (V74) plus a second-generation foldable iPhone (V78), all powered by a 2-nanometer A21 chip internally codenamed Naxos
key_facts.excerpt: Gurman also mentioned the long-rumored '20th anniversary' iPhone, dubbed V73 and V74, which he says will follow this year's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max offering similar sizes, but adding a 'nearly edge-to-edge display, with curved glass that wraps around the sides.'

key_facts.fact: This year's iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and first-generation foldable will use the A20 Pro processor codenamed Borneo, while next year's base iPhone 18 will run the A20 Banda; Apple is also preparing an A22 Pro for 2028 that may be built on a 1.4-nanometer process
key_facts.excerpt: This year's iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and first-generation foldable iPhone will use an A20 Pro processor code-named Borneo. The standard iPhone 18 model arriving next year will run on a base A20 chip known internally as Banda.

key_facts.fact: The quick foldable follow-up — just a year after the first model — signals Apple is treating foldables as an annual product category
key_facts.excerpt: Also mentioned is a second-generation foldable phone to follow the model that he says we can expect to see this fall, as an indication that Apple will be committed to the new product category
